result.question: Qual o total de internações por ano?
result.gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes GROUP BY ano ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC;
result.generated_sql: SELECT ano, COUNT(*) AS total FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes i GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") ) sub WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;
